{{Quote|Come on, smuggler.|Unidentified officer|<ref name="TSC" />}}
This '''individual''' was an officer on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]]. Sometime in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the officer assisted in the arrest of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]] after he betrayed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]  [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the crime boss [[Traygura]]. A brief [[Skirmish at Traygura’s Hideout|skirmish]] broke out in her [[Traygura's hideout|hideout]] but the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] emerged victorious with help from with help from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="TSC" />
